entries.name: compiler
entries.description:
The compiler for files compiled without a collection (e.g. `page.mdx` routes).

Collections choose their own compiler via the collection-level `compiler` option.

entries.name: mdxOptions
entries.description: Configure global MDX options, used by `doc` collections with the default MDX compiler.

entries.name: satteriOptions
entries.description: Configure global Sätteri options, used by `doc` collections with `compiler: "satteri"`.

entries.name: workspaces
entries.type: Record<string, { dir: string; config: Record<string, unknown>; }> | undefined
